title: Least-severe correlated reverse stress
prompt: Factor shock coordinates are in percentage points. Portfolio loss in USD million is8*x+5*y. Severity is sqrt(s' Sigma^-1 s), where Sigma is the supplied positive definite shock covariance. Over all real shock pairs, find the unique minimum-severity shock whose loss is at least30. Report shock [x,y], severity, and loss at that shock.
